product_overview: Wateen is an on‑demand home nursing platform for Egypt that enables patients to request visits, receive price estimates, and leverages spatial matching to dispatch nearby nurses securely and quickly.
core_goals: Enable fast, reliable on‑demand nursing visits with geo-aware auto-dispatch
Provide transparent, auditable pricing with immutability for visit charges
Support real-time nurse workflows (offers, acceptance) via authenticated APIs and WebSockets
Design for Egyptian market constraints: Arabic-first RTL UI, offline resilience, and local payment options
Protect patient data and consent (privacy, audit trails, and immutable logs for sensitive assets)

features.name: Auto-Dispatch (Visit Request & Matching)
features.description: Patient creates a visit request which triggers the spatial matching engine to find candidate nurses; top candidates receive dispatch offers and first-accept-wins logic assigns a nurse.
user_flows: Authenticate (obtain access token) -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/request/ -> POST visit payload {service_type, lat, lng, notes, vitals_consent} -> Receive 201 Created with visit_id and status=PENDING -> System performs GEOSEARCH and ranks candidates -> Offer messages published to nurse channels -> Nurse accepts via /api/v1/visits/nurse/respond-offer/ -> Visit status updates to ACCEPTED and nurse_id assigned -> Patient receives notification with nurse name and ETA

Authenticate (obtain access token) -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/request/ -> POST visit payload with invalid coordinates -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors -> Fix coordinates -> Re-POST visit payload -> Receive 201 Created

Authenticate (obtain access token) -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/request/ -> POST visit payload -> Receive 201 Created with status=PENDING -> Wait matching timeout (no accept within round) -> System expands search radius and retries matching -> After max rounds, receive 'delayed' notification and visit queued for manual dispatch -> Patient sees estimated delay message

features.name: Price Estimate & Price Immutability
features.description: Unauthenticated public endpoint returns a transparent price breakdown (base, distance, night fee, total). The Visit model stores final price fields at creation and those fields are locked to prevent post‑hoc changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /api/v1/visits/estimate/ -> POST {lat, lng, service_id} -> Receive 200 OK with price_breakdown {base_price, distance_fee, night_fee, total} -> Review estimate and confirm booking via /api/v1/visits/request/
Navigate to /api/v1/visits/estimate/ -> POST with missing service_id -> Receive 400 Bad Request with field validation error -> Provide service_id -> Re-POST and receive valid price_breakdown

Authenticate (obtain access token) -> Create visit via /api/v1/visits/request/ -> Receive Visit resource containing final_price and price_breakdown fields -> Observe final_price present and marked as immutable in response schema (read-only) -> Attempting to change price in follow-up update is rejected by server (operation denied / validation error)

features.name: Nurse Respond to Dispatch Offer
features.description: Nurses receive dispatch offers and respond via the nurse-facing API; the system enforces timeouts and first-accept-wins semantics and updates visit state accordingly.
user_flows: Authenticate as nurse (obtain nurse JWT) -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/nurse/respond-offer/ -> POST {visit_id, action: 'accept'} -> Receive 200 OK confirming acceptance -> Visit status transitions to ACCEPTED and nurse assigned -> Patient and nurse are notified of assignment and ETA

Authenticate as nurse (obtain nurse JWT) -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/nurse/respond-offer/ -> POST {visit_id, action: 'decline'} -> Receive 200 OK confirming decline -> System continues to offer to remaining candidates
Attempt to POST to /api/v1/visits/nurse/respond-offer/ without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Nurse is prompted to login before responding

Authenticate as nurse -> Navigate to /api/v1/visits/nurse/respond-offer/ -> POST {visit_id, action: 'accept'} after offer timeout -> Receive 409 Conflict or 400 with 'offer expired' message -> Offer cannot be accepted and nurse sees failure response

features.name: Price Immutability
features.description: Locked pricing fields in Visit model

known_limitations.impact: Background commands take longer to return output
